value: Mr. Shiny and New 安宇
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    u.Id AS user_id,
    u.DisplayName AS user_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS accepted_answer_count
FROM main."users" u
LEFT JOIN main."posts" p 
    ON p.Id IN (
        SELECT AcceptedAnswerId 
        FROM main."posts" 
        WHERE AcceptedAnswerId IS NOT NULL
    )
    AND p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
    AND p.CreaionDate >= DATE '2013-06-01'
    AND p.CreaionDate < DATE '2013-07-01'
WHERE u.CreationDate <= TIMESTAMP '2013-08-01'
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY accepted_answer_count DESC, u.Id
```
